model_output.verdict: Your move from accounts payable to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply gives you a clear accounting story. I'd hesitate to move the resume forward because the duties don't show how much of the close you handle.
write_up: It's common for accounting resumes to list the regular duties of a job. Yours shows a move from accounts payable into staff accounting at Rivermark, but the duties don't yet show how much work you handle or what you've contributed beyond the basics. That makes it harder to stand out among other Staff Accountant resumes.

The journal entries and reconciliations line is a useful starting model because it names two things you prepare. Your degree and accounting tools also support the direction; what's missing is the detail that shows how those tools and duties fit into your work at Rivermark.
Let's start with the month-end close line. Name the tasks you handle and the accounts or volume involved, then do the same for the audit and fixed assets. Use only details you can confirm.
